Why This Matters

CDC guidance says children and adolescents ages 6 to 17 should get 60 minutes or more of moderate-to-vigorous physical activity daily. CDC

CDC also recommends muscle-strengthening and bone-strengthening activity at least 3 days a week for ages 6 to 17. CDC

For local school-age families, this is one more structured movement option in a small rural PK to 12 district where NCES lists 333 students for 2024 to 2025, while CDC guidance recommends at least 60 minutes of daily activity for ages 6 to 17. NCES

This Week's Curriculum

Links Browse the beginner BJJ glossary.

The Vale-Tudo / closed-guard theme: "Whoever manages the distance manages the damage." Gracie Academy

Defending the Back Ride: Under 2024 IBJJF rules, back control is 4 points after 3 seconds of stabilized control. IBJJF Rules (UFAF mirror)

Attacking from Closed Guard: A sweep from guard/half guard is 2 points after 3 seconds of stabilization. IBJJF Rules (UFAF mirror)

Standing Up from Closed Guard: A stand-up reversal from guard can also score 2 points when control is established for 3 seconds. IBJJF Rules (UFAF mirror)

What EBI-Style Overtime Means

Our event uses an EBI-style submission-only format: no points in regulation, then controlled overtime from defined finishing positions if needed.

Regulation is commonly described as 10 minutes, submission only, then overtime starting from back control or spiderweb with alternating attack and escape turns; if neither athlete gets a submission, escape time can decide the winner. FloGrappling

Many EBI-format events run a single overtime round in bracket matches and up to 3 overtime rounds in finals. Submission Challenge See 12-week program pricing.
